design:
# Plan: mimid-1wgh.3 — mimi-room-policy (draft-ietf-mimi-room-policy-04)

Approved by Mark 2026-10-17.

## Mark's decisions
- No dependency on mimi-mls (confirmed: only scalar MLS typedefs appear; claims come in as plain data). Deps: tls_codec =0.5.0 (derive, mls).
- Oracle: phnx-im/mimi-room-policy does NOT match -04 on the wire (pre-split single RoomPolicy, u8 capabilities, no role_index); reference only. Codec oracle = hand-encoded hex from Appendix B.
- MediaType duplicated here and in mimi-mls with a conversion at the hub (keeps this crate MLS-free).
- Hub enforcement in v1: membership capabilities (§8.1) + canSendMessage; all other capabilities encoded and carried but not enforced.

## Encoding
All TLS presentation language (Appendix B, line ~3589). No CBOR (ClaimId carries CWT claim key as opaque). Components are ComponentData.data (ext-10 §4.6) / AppDataUpdate.update (ext-10 §4.7). tls_codec 0.5 has no bool: local `Bool` rejecting values other than 0/1. Use `mls` feature (30-bit varints, RFC 9420 §2.1.2).

## Type model
| Component (suggested ID) | Rust type |
|---|---|
| mls_operational_policy 0x0024 | OperationalParameters + sub-structs (codec only) |
| roles_list 0x0025 | RoleData{roles: Vec<Role>}; Role per §3; Option<u32> max constraints; Vec<RoleChange{from, to: Vec<u32>}> |
| preauth_list 0x0026 | PreAuthData{entries: Vec<PreAuthRoleEntry{claimset, target_role: Role}>}; ClaimId{credential_type: u16, id: VLBytes} |
| base_room_policy 0x0027 | BaseRoomPolicy; parent_room: Vec<Uri>; policy_component_ids: Vec<u16> |
| status_notification 0x0028 | StatusNotificationPolicy; Optionality u8 enum |
| join_link_policy / join_links 0x0029/0x002A | JoinLinkPolicy, Vec<JoinLink>, JoinLinksUpdate (only delta-updated component) |
| link_preview 0x002B, logging 0x002D, history 0x002E, expiration 0x0030 | Rust enums on Optionality |
| asset_policy 0x002C | AssetPolicy; permitted_media_types: Option<Vec<MediaType>> |
| bot_policy 0x002F | BotPolicy{allowed_bots: Vec<Bot>} |
| §10.2 registry | Capability(u16) newtype + consts + name(); unknown/private-use 0xF000-0xFFFF round-trip |

## Evaluation API
```rust
pub trait Occupancy { fn participants(&self, role: u32) -> u32; fn active(&self, role: u32) -> u32; }
impl RoleData {
  fn role(&self, idx: u32) -> Option<&Role>;
  fn has_capability(&self, idx: u32, c: Capability) -> bool;
  fn validate(&self, base: &BaseRoomPolicy) -> Result<(), PolicyError>;
  fn authorize(&self, actor_role: u32, action: MembershipAction) -> Result<(), Denied>;
  fn check_constraints(&self, after: &impl Occupancy) -> Result<(), Denied>;
}
impl PreAuthData { fn first_match(&self, claims: &[Claim]) -> Option<u32>; }
```
MembershipAction: Add, Remove, RemoveSelf, AddOwnClient, RemoveOwnClient, Kick, ChangeUserRole{from,to}, ChangeOwnRole{from,to}, OpenJoin{to}, JoinIfPreauthorized{to}, UseJoinCode{to}.
validate: unique role indexes; canOpenJoin only on role 0 (§8.1.1); fixed_membership => no canAddParticipant on roles >=2 (§5); role 1 named "banned" if present (§8.1.3); history-sharing roles not 0/1/zero-max-active (§6.6).
Hub (not this crate): participant-list state, mapping MLS ops to actions, self-vs-other, commit-level rules (role update can't share commit with participant changes §3; preauth likewise except removals §4), max_clients/max_users/multi_device vs MLS group, client removal on ban, join-code validity, credential claim extraction, fanout withholding (§8.3).

## Oracles
No hex/vectors in the draft. Codec: hand-encoded hex from Appendix B, commented, minimal + maximal per struct, plus rejections (bool=2, 8-byte varint, trailing bytes). Registry: Table 1 transcribed. Evaluation: Appendix A.1-A.4 role tables as Rust literals; allow/deny expectations from §8.1 prose.

## Decision records (filed): P1-P17, see decisions under this issue.

## Risks
A -05 will likely change Claims (§4 "TODO: refactor Claims"), the `case extension` arm, and IDs; exact pins + DRs limit churn.
notes: 2026-10-17 (Mark): plan rule 'role 1 named banned' replaced by decision mimid-1wgh.3.42 (role 1 need not be named banned; Role::is_banned_role identifies it).
